title: A job endpoint for crew rosters
heading: Submit Returns 202 and an Id, Poll Returns a Status, Fetch Returns the Result
cases: a submitted job gets 202 and an id, its poll reaches the solve's status, and its fetch returns the solve's result
submit answers at once while the solve is still running
with one worker busy, a second job polls as queued, not running
an id the API never gave out gets 404 on poll and on fetch
fetching a job that has not finished gets 409, and 200 once it has
a solve that raises leaves its job failed with the reason, and the next job still runs
a queued job's poll counts the queued jobs submitted before it, not the running one
